**Native forest tree-cover loss was detected in 2022, but the evidence does not establish whether it was deforestation.**

About 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss was mapped on the 17.6 ha property. Of that area, 0.5 ha was mapped as native forest in Uruguay’s 2021 forest map; the remaining 0.1 ha was outside mapped forest. A separate 2020 forest reference agreed that the entire loss area was forest.

Tree-cover loss can result from several causes and does not by itself establish a change in land use. The cause of the loss is unknown.
